protocol.visibility: At least eight target pixels in the simulator segmentation render; not supplied to the controller.
protocol.match: Selected detection centroid falls inside the target segmentation mask.
protocol.centering: Visible target projected center lies within 20 pixels of image center; denominator is ALL frames, including occlusion.
protocol.error: Mean projected target-center error on geometrically visible frames only; inspect visible fraction alongside it.
protocol.reacquisition: Time after the screen removal at 5.2 s until a correct detection is in TRACK state; null means never reacquired.
protocol.freeze: Detector threshold was adjusted on development seed 7; no tuning after reserved-seed evaluation.
